description: Java class 'JsonQuery' providing an immutable representation of a JSON-based query with methods for extracting and comparing parameter values.

classes.name: JsonQuery
classes.description: Immutable class wrapping a JSON query with methods to extract and compare parameters.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a JsonQuery instance from JSON command and parsed query.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the original JSON query string.

methods.name: parsedJson
methods.description: Returns the parsed JSON element.

methods.name: differenceExists
methods.description: Overloaded private methods to determine if there is a difference between base and working copy values for various data types.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the JSON query.

methods.name: hasParameter
methods.description: Alias for parameterExists.

methods.name: dateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the 'dateFormat' parameter value.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Retrieves the 'locale' parameter value.

methods.name: mapValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a map of string to boolean for a given parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInLongParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a Long parameter has changed compared to existing value.

methods.name: longValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDate parameter has changed.

methods.name: localDateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalDate value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInStringParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a String parameter has changed.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a String value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInBigDecimalParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal parameter has changed.

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an Integer parameter has changed.

methods.name: integerValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInBooleanParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a Boolean parameter has changed.

methods.name: booleanObjectValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a Boolean object (nullable) for a parameter.

methods.name: booleanPrimitiveValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a primitive boolean value for a parameter, defaults to false if null.

methods.name: isChangeInArrayParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an array parameter has changed.

methods.name: arrayValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves an array of strings for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInPasswordParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a password parameter has changed, considering encoding.

methods.name: passwordValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Encodes a password parameter using the provided encoder and salt.
